post.text:
What an amazing first day at KartMania, meeting hundreds of you guys and seeing so many of you in our brand new UMK merch!

Thank you so much for coming to see me, have a photo & a chat - and supporting the channel.

It’s so cool to see this channel’s viewers in real life, and I’m looking forward to meeting many more of you tomorrow.

Find me at the Helmet28 / Xenduri stand and grab a free poster at 11AM & 2PM.

And if you haven’t already, remember to try the new USE MORE KERB app by heading to this link: https://usemorekerb.com


#KartMania #Karting #Silverstone
